filters.title: Filters and performance
filters.description:
Turn on the features you want. Reload your browser after changing anything that mentions card files.

- **Entity filtering:** send only the entities your dashboards use.
- **Device and area filtering:** trim the entity, device and area lists the same way.
- **Live updates for current tab only:** after the page loads, keep only the tab you're viewing live. Needs entity filtering.
- **Skip unused card files:** don't load card files that no dashboard uses.
- **Load current tab first:** load the current tab's card files before the rest.
- **Preload card files:** start downloading card files as early as possible.
- **Delay graph loading:** wait to load off-screen graphs until you scroll to them.
- **Pause off-screen animations** and **Pause animations during loading:** pause repeating animations you can't see, or while the dashboard loads.
- **Idle mode:** pause live updates after inactivity. Needs entity filtering.

rules.title: Entity rules
rules.description: Loona finds the entities your dashboards use on its own. Add any it missed under Included, or leave some out under Excluded. You can add whole entity types (like sensor), specific entity IDs, or patterns such as sensor.kitchen_*. Exclusions win over inclusions. People, update and zone entities that Home Assistant needs are always kept.

confirm_remove_dashboard.title: Remove the Loona dashboard
confirm_remove_dashboard.description: Remove the Loona dashboard that Loona created, along with its cards? Dashboards you've edited yourself are kept. Cancel to keep things as they are.

idle.title: Idle timing
idle.description: Choose how long the dashboard waits before going idle, and how often it refreshes while idle. Set refresh to 0 to stop refreshing until someone uses the dashboard; otherwise pick 1 to 60 seconds (default 60). Clocks, cameras and some cards may keep updating on their own.
